name: CES 232 右主起落架 通场 等待

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 232, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are taxiing Southbound on taxiway Charlie to holding point runway 36L, call Wuhan Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 232，从武汉飞往新加坡，正在 Charlie 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point runway 36L, request takeoff clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，请求起飞许可。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Tower, line up and wait runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉塔台，跑道 36L 进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 36L, CES232.

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, wind calm, cleared for takeoff runway 36L, contact Wuhan Departure 118.25 when airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，风静，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离地后联系武汉离场 118.25。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, the indication shows your right main gear has not been retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1500 meters and speed 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，指示显示右主起落架未收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, we have an undercarriage warning, our right main gear has not been retracted, request maintain 1500m and speed 200kts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，我们有起落架警告，右主起落架未收上，请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Approach, roger, climb and maintain 1500 meters, speed 200 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉进近，收到，爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节同意，能够时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1500m, speed 200 knots, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节，CES232。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the abnormal checklist, you still cannot confirm the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成非正常检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, we cannot confirm the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, turn right track direct to Echo Bravo NDB, descend and maintain 1200 meters, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，右转直飞 Echo Bravo NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200m, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES232。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, you are 11 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，你距接地点 11 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。

cards.audioText: B: Call Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you have established ILS runway 36R and you are ready for the low-pass.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫武汉塔台并告诉管制员你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, established ILS runway 36R, ready for low-pass.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, wind calm, cleared low-pass runway 36R, not below 200 meters above the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared low-pass runway 36R, not below 200m above the runway, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米，CES232。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, after low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: After low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200m, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米，CES232。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 232, we’ve had a good look at your undercarriage, your right main gear seems to be in the extended position, advise intentions.
B: Tell Wuhan Tower the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, you want to perform a hold over Whiskey Hotel Alpha as published.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 232，我们已看清你的起落架，你的右主起落架似乎在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉武汉塔台指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，你想在 Whiskey Hotel Alpha 上空按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES232, the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, request hold over WHA as published.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES232，指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，请求在 WHA 按公布程序等待。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, turn left proceed direct to Delta Alpha, climb and maintain 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.225.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，左转直飞 Delta Alpha，爬升并保持 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.225。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.225, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，119.225，CES232。

cards.audioText: B: You are tracking direct to Delta Alpha, maintaining 1500 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正直飞 Delta Alpha，保持 1500 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES232, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500m, request holding instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES232，正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 232, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at Delta Alpha as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 232，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 Delta Alpha 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold, CES232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待，CES232。
